surface: src/plate_core/spec_audit.py, gh plate spec-audit, plate_spec_audit MCP
summary: SPEC audit engine first slice (#338): structured findings (aligned/undocumented/stale_evidence/future_ok) from SPEC.md + unreleased fragments + path citations; CLI gh plate spec-audit and MCP plate_spec_audit for agent consumption.
migration_impact: New optional audit surface. Does not auto-edit SPEC.md. Agents can list undocumented fragments for Documentation PRs. Follow-ups #339/#340 add issue generation and health exposure.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core for gh plate spec-audit / plate_spec_audit.
2. Run from repo root: gh plate spec-audit --json.
3. Triage undocumented findings into Documentation PRs that add implemented+tested behavior to SPEC.
4. Do not treat future-only SPEC sections as errors.
agent_notes: Use plate_spec_audit before claiming SPEC is current. Prefer additive SPEC updates for undocumented features with tests. Quiet ops: one-line summary of counts unless asked for full findings.
